title: The Dog Night, 2017
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Eighteen years. The dumpster's gone. A recycling bin. The strip stands where it was.

panels.composition: Behind the Lanes. The bulb. Where the dumpster stood: a blue municipal recycling bin, clean, wheeled. The chain-link. WOOD and BARNABY II standing where the dumpster was.

image.prompt: a man and a three-legged dog standing behind a bowling alley at night under a bulb where a rusted dumpster used to be, a clean blue wheeled recycling bin there instead, clean ink, no words
image.notes: The dumpster is gone. A recycling bin. The strip stands on the spot.

panels.composition: The gravel. A rust stain in the shape of the dumpster's footprint. Wood's boot at its edge.

characters.pose: boot at the edge of the stain

image.prompt: close-up of gravel stained with a rectangular rust outline where a dumpster stood for years, a man's boot at its edge, no words

panels.composition: Wood sitting on the gravel inside the stain's outline. The pup in his lap. The bin behind them, blue and wrong.

image.prompt: a man sitting on gravel inside a rust-stained rectangular outline with a three-legged dog in his lap, a clean blue recycling bin behind them, bulb light, no words

panels.composition: The sign. Five letters dark: S _ ALL W _ _ D L _ NES. Wood walking under it with the pup.

image.prompt: a man and a three-legged dog walking beneath a bowling-alley neon sign with five letters gone dark, night, no words
image.notes: Five dark. Draw the sign so the dead letters are legible as gaps.

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: The dumpster gone. He sits in its outline. Five dark.
